Build Versus screens in Fight, Fantasy, or SF with up to six characters per side, team colors, boss entrances, individual voices, and combat-start playback.
Arrange and save cut-in sequences with transitions, an optional shared background, and continuous music.

announcement.title: 🎬 Cinematic Cut-ins v3.0.0
announcement.content:
v3.0.0: Versus Screens and Cut-in Sequences

  • Introduce both sides with Fight, Fantasy, or SF Versus screens. Set team colors, boss entrances, individual voices, and automatic playback when combat starts.
  • Arrange cut-ins with transitions, a shared background, and continuous music. Save through existing presets and play from the editor, control panel, macros, or triggers.
  • Move and trim timeline bars to set start and end times. Layer visibility and effects have separate intervals, with speed and strength controlled separately.
  • Choose seven character movements and seven layer animations. Rotate text and artwork in the preview. Tarot and Paper Theater add card-flip and paper-stage entrances.
  • D&D5e and PF2e gain attack critical-failure conditions, with Midi-QOL and RSReforged support for D&D5e. Non-attack checks can use PF2e critical failure or D&D5e's kept natural 1.
  • Fixed Stellar boxed framing, masks, editing scroll, interrupted effects, and roll-trigger handling. Existing Stellar boxed presets may need position and scale adjustments.
